verdict.rationale: Heap is an analytics SaaS with AI features (Sense Chat), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no documented control or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. PII redaction (heap-ignore, disableTextCapture) and the user-deletion API are adjacent privacy controls, not an AI-training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
